text.p: -- J.P. Morgan steel analyst Mike Gambardella said he raised his '97 estimate on Allegheny Teledyne Inc to $1.90 per share from $1.85 per share.
-- Gambardella also said he raised his '98 estimate on Allegheny to $2.40 per share from $2.25 per share.
-- Gambardella said he raised his estimates due to a 12 million share repurchase program the company announced on Thursday.

-- "The program is 60 percent larger than the plan we anticipated," he said. "We consider (the announcement) only one in what should be a series of aggressive actions by management and the board to increase shareholder value."
-- Gambardella said that even if the company fully executes the stock repurchase program by year-end '98, it will still be able to decrease its debt to total capital ratio to 14 percent.
-- Shares were trading at 28-3/8, up 1-1/8 in late morning exchange trading.
